'''''Polypogon maritimus''''' is a species of [[Poaceae|grass]] known by the common names '''Mediterranean beard grass''' and '''Mediterranean rabbitsfoot grass'''. It is native to the [[Mediterranean Basin]]. It is also known in other parts of the world, including [[Australia]], [[New Zealand]], and the [[United States]], as an [[introduced species]] that can be found in moist habitat types. It is an annual grass producing stems up to half a meter tall. The [[inflorescence]] is a plumelike [[panicle]] up to 15 centimeters long containing many V-shaped spikelets with long [[Awn (botany)|awns]].
